title: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon 2026 Review | Miri, Sarawak
meta_description: Dynasty Charity Half Marathon review: 1,800 runners from 11 countries in Miri in October 2025, a race run for charity for more than two decades.
dek: Dynasty Hotel Miri's charity half marathon has been raising money for the town's elderly and single mothers for more than 20 years. Here is what the October 2025 edition was like.
verdict: The Dynasty Charity Half Marathon is a small, long-running charity race in Miri. The 2025 edition, in October, drew 1,800 runners from 11 countries, up from about 1,400 the year before [1]. The money raised goes to people in need in Miri, including the elderly and single mothers, and the hotel's partnership with the state welfare department has given more than RM1.5 million over two decades [1]. If you want a friendly, community-minded half marathon in northern Sarawak where your entry fee does some good, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race drew 1,800 runners from 11 countries, an increase on the roughly 1,400 who ran the year before, according to Sarawak's minister for women, children and community wellbeing [1]. The theme was Run for Charity [1].
TVS described 2025 as the race's 22nd year [1]; the organiser's registration listing numbers the 2026 race as the 22nd edition. Either way, it has been run for more than two decades.

sections.heading: A Race for Miri's Welfare
paragraphs: Proceeds from entries and public and private donations go to Miri's less fortunate, including the elderly and single mothers [1]. The minister said the partnership between Dynasty Hotel and the state welfare department has given more than RM1.5 million over the years, benefiting thousands of welfare recipients [1].
TVS called it one of the longest continuously run charity events in Sarawak [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon in Miri with a clear charitable purpose, yes. The field is growing but still small, so expect a friendly local race.
The reporting on 2025 is about the charity, not the course or results, so check route and start details with the organisers before you travel.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: 1,800 runners from 11 countries took part in the October 2025 edition in Miri, Sarawak, up from about 1,400 the year before. The race is organised by Dynasty Hotel Miri.

faqs.question: What does the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon support?
faqs.answer: People in need in Miri, including the elderly and single mothers. Over more than two decades, the partnership between Dynasty Hotel and the Sarawak welfare department has given more than RM1.5 million in aid.

faqs.question: How long has the Dynasty Charity Half Marathon been running?
faqs.answer: More than 20 years. TVS described 2025 as its 22nd year, while the organiser's listing numbers the 2026 race as the 22nd edition. It is one of the longest continuously run charity events in Sarawak.
